mathematics.geometry: One connected 18-vertex, 96-dart spherical triangulation with a complete cyclic D0092 core reading; named exterior is isomorphic to the actual 11-vertex induced exterior.
mathematics.static: Identical seven core lists imply the same joint internal assignment relation; for any proper exterior colouring this relation is equivalent to actual extension.
mathematics.failed_assertion: A deterministic rooted 0/3 switch at boundary vertex 2 descends to the core-list summary. Same initial lists yield different actual components, different resulting profiles, and different extension outcomes.
mathematics.obstruction: One result forces adjacent core vertices 12 and 13 both to colour zero; the other has an explicit genuine ambient colouring.
mathematics.constructive_repair: Switching the actual 1/3-component {4,5,6} in the second initial colouring yields the first. GSLT component histories compose with the successful 0/3 switch and reconstruct the full colouring.
limitations: Two specified exterior colourings; no arbitrary-exterior reducibility theorem.
